registerSubtitle: Access and erasure requests from people about their personal data

typeLong.access: Access request: a copy of the data we hold
typeLong.erasure: Erasure request: delete the person's data

identityMethod.known_contact_details: Confirmed through contact details we hold

overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Due today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
emptyDetail: Log a request when a person asks for a copy of their data or for it to be erased.
newSubtitle: The request is due one month after it reached us.
personHelp: Search by name, phone or reference.
personRequired: Choose the person the request is about.
receivedOnHelp: The due date is one month after this date.
summaryHelp: What the person asked for. Do not copy ID or bank numbers.
assignConsequence: The member is not told automatically; let them know.
verifyConsequence: Record how you confirmed that the request comes from this person. This cannot be changed later.
noteHelp: What was seen or confirmed. No document numbers.
statusConsequence: The change is recorded in the request's history.
outcomeNoteHelp: Told to the requester when refusing; how they withdrew when recording a withdrawal.
extendConsequence: A due date can be extended once, by up to 60 days, with the reason. Tell the requester.
evidenceConsequence: Evidence cannot be changed; a correction is a new entry.
fulfilNeedsWork: Verify the requester's identity and start work before fulfilling the request.
fulfilNotAllowed: Only a member who can fulfil requests (the company owner) carries this out.
reportConsequence: The report contains everything we hold about this person, including protected details such as identity numbers. It is recorded in the audit log, and you can download it for 24 hours.
reportExpired: The report has expired. Produce it again if needed.
reportNotYours: Produced by another member; only they can download it.
eraseConsequence: Their name, contact details, protected details and notes are removed, and text about them is replaced with [Erased]. Records the law requires us to keep stay. This cannot be undone.
erasedLine: Erasure carried out and recorded in the erasure ledger.
blockedTitle: This person cannot be erased now
blockedHelp: Refuse the request with the reason, or resolve the records first.

blocker.organisation: Organisations are not erased; archive the organisation instead.
blocker.records: Records the law requires us to keep refer to this person: {records}.

evidenceNoNumbers: Do not copy ID or bank numbers.
